newsitem.title: USA: Giant sees Q4 shr $0.06-$0.09 vs $0.32.
newsitem.headline: Giant sees Q4 shr $0.06-$0.09 vs $0.32.

text.p: Giant Industries Inc said it expects to report earnings of between $0.06 and $0.09 per share for the fourth quarter ended December 31, because of lower refining margins.
That compares to earnings of $0.32 per share for the fourth quarter of 1995, the company said, adding that the reduced refining margins stemmed in part from higher raw material costs.
The company also said that in the fourth quarter, it experienced the highest crude oil costs since the Persian Gulf crisis in 1990.
The company also said it expects to report earnings for the full year of between $1.51 per share and $1.54 per share, compared with $0.69 per share for the 1995 year.
